name: Otyugh
languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition. Whenever the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} target finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) and doesn't return to normal until the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition ends on the target. {@actSaveSuccess} The {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition ends.

action.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the otyugh. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, the target becomes {@variantrule Stable|SRD52}, and it has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. While {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}, the target also has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition.

bonus.name: Ethereal Jaunt
entries: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

action.name: Enthralling Panache

action.name: Pistol

trait.name: Diabolical Restoration
entries: If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

trait.name: Fear Aura
entries: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} while it doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition. {@actSave wis} {@dc 21}, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pit fiend has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 8}) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. {@actSave con} {@dc 21}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition. While {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} and takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

action.name: Devilish Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Fiery Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) Force damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Fire damage.

spellcasting.name: Hellfire Spellcasting {@recharge 4}
headerEntries: The pit fiend casts {@spell Fireball|SRD52} (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 21}). It can replace one {@spell Fireball|SRD52} with {@spell Hold Monster|SRD52} (level 7 version) or {@spell Wall of Fire|SRD52}.

action.name: Radiant Sword

action.name: Holy Burst
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 20}, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

headerEntries: The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

headerEntries: The planetar casts {@spell Cure Wounds|SRD52}, {@spell Invisibility|SRD52}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|SRD52}, or {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Radiant Flame

entries: The pseudodragon makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Sting
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, one creature the pseudodragon can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. While {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}, the target also has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition, which ends early if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

trait.name: Tunneler
entries: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its {@variantrule Burrow Speed|SRD52} and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d8 + 9}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 19}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Tail Stinger
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) Piercing damage plus 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the worm, and the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} and {@condition Restrained|SRD52} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|SRD52}.

action.name: Shape-Shift

Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Fiendish Restoration

action.name: Cursed Touch

While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

action.name: Baleful Command {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 18}, each enemy in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the rakshasa. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} and {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} conditions until the start of the rakshasa's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

vulnerable.note: damage from weapons wielded by creatures under the effect of a {@spell Bless|SRD52} spell

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition ends. entries: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Antennae
entries: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, the creature with the object. {@actSaveFail} The object takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). The penalty can be removed by casting the {@spell Mending|SRD52} spell on the armor or weapon.

action.name: Destroy Metal

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. The target has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 14}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until the grapple ends.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The satyr has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

action.name: Mockery
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hag can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Vile Appearance
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11}, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag's true form. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this hag's Vile Appearance for 24 hours.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Death Glare {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11}, one {@condition Frightened|SRD52} creature the hag can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} If the target has 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or fewer, it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. Otherwise, the target takes 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 11}): {@spell Augury|SRD52}, {@spell Find Familiar|SRD52}, {@spell Identify|SRD52}, {@spell Locate Object|SRD52}, {@spell Scrying|SRD52}, or {@spell Unseen Servant|SRD52}. The hag must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Illusory Appearance
headerEntries: The hag casts {@spell Disguise Self|SRD52}, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}). The spell's duration is 24 hours.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Sunlight Weakness
entries: While in sunlight, the shadow has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule D20 Test|SRD52|D20 Tests}.

action.name: Draining Swipe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by {@dice 1d4}. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse {@dice 1d4} hours later.

bonus.name: Shadow Stealth
entries: While in {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, the shadow takes the {@action Hide|SRD52} action.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

action.name: Charged Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the shambling mound pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Engulf
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled into the shambling mound's space and has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 14}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} and {@condition Restrained|SRD52} conditions, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by this action at a time.
